about: Functions FormCel computes. args come from the syntax on each Microsoft function page, or the Google page for functions only Sheets has; excel.listed and excel.since from Microsoft's alphabetical function list; sheets.listed and sheets.category from Google's function list; both lists fetched 2026-10-21. summary is FormCel's own wording.
